paper.title_en: Apparent horizon thermodynamics in an exponential $f(Q)$ gravity model
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamics of the apparent horizon in an exponential $f(Q)$ gravity model characterized by the two parameters $b$ and $n$, within a spatially flat Friedmann--Lemaître--Robertson--Walker background and the coincident gauge. Focusing on the $n=1$ solution, we use the approximate cosmological solution for the Hubble parameter up to second order in the exponential parameter $b$ to study the redshift evolution of the apparent-horizon radius and the Kodama--Hayward temperature. We formulate Hayward's unified first law in terms of the Misner--Sharp--Hernandez mass, the work density, and the energy-supply vector, and show that the horizon dynamics admits an equilibrium thermodynamic description. The associated entropy differential is proportional to $f_Q+2Qf_{QQ}$, yielding exponentially suppressed corrections to the Bekenstein--Hawking area law and recovering $S=A/4$ in the limit $b\to0$. We then examine the generalized second law (GSL) by including the entropy of matter inside the apparent horizon. When the matter and horizon temperatures are identified, we adopt the GSL viability criterion $f_Q+2Qf_{QQ}\geq0$ previously derived in the literature. The observationally motivated best-fit values of $b$ satisfy this condition over the redshift interval studied and produce departures from $Λ$CDM mainly at late times. In contrast, sufficiently large positive values, approximately $b>0.26$, can violate the GSL in the future region $z<0$. These results show that apparent-horizon thermodynamics provides a complementary constraint on the parameter space of exponential $f(Q)$ cosmology.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将视界热力学与广义第二定律应用于指数型 f(Q) 引力模型，推导出熵修正并给出参数空间的观测约束，与黑洞热力学主题高度相关，理论推导清晰且具有潜在后续研究价值。
decision.title_zh: 指数型 $f(Q)$ 引力模型中的表观视界热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了以两个参数 $b$ 和 $n$ 为特征的指数型 $f(Q)$ 引力模型中表观视界的热力学，背景为空间平坦的 Friedmann--Lemaître--Robertson--Walker 度规并采用重合规范。聚焦于 $n=1$ 的解，我们使用哈勃参数在指数参数 $b$ 中最高至二阶的近似宇宙学解，来研究表观视界半径和 Kodama--Hayward 温度的红移演化。我们用 Misner--Sharp--Hernandez 质量、功密度和能量供给矢量来表述 Hayward 的统一第一定律，并表明视界动力学允许一个平衡态热力学描述。相关的熵微分正比于 $f_Q+2Qf_{QQ}$，产生对 Bekenstein--Hawking 面积定律的指数压制修正，并在 $b\to0$ 的极限下恢复 $S=A/4$。然后我们通过包含表观视界内部物质的熵来检验广义第二定律（GSL）。当物质温度和视界温度被认同时，我们采用文献中先前导出的 GSL 可行性判据 $f_Q+2Qf_{QQ}\geq0$。观测上得到的最佳拟合 $b$ 值在研究红移区间内满足该条件，并主要在晚期产生对 $\Lambda$CDM 的偏离。相反，足够大的正值，大约 $b>0.26$，可以在未来区域 $z<0$ 违反 GSL。这些结果表明，表观视界热力学为指数型 $f(Q)$ 宇宙学的参数空间提供了一个补充约束。
